routes.name: NW Face Var. (Remsberg Variation)
routes.overview: A harder finish variation to the standard Northwest Face route, established by Dale Remsberg and Scott Stimpson. Adds flaring 5.10d crack climbing through the upper half of the face in place of the standard route's easier finish.

routes.name: East Face
routes.overview: A 6-pitch, Grade III 5.10- moderate alpine rock route up the East Face of the smallest tower in the Liberty Bell Group, climbing progressively better rock to a stellar hand-crack finish near the summit.

routes.name: North Ridge - West Side
routes.overview: A moderate alpine route on Molar Tooth's north ridge featuring 2-3 low to moderate 5th class pitches up the west rib to the summit, with excellent granite climbing punctuated by loose rock hazards and quality variations.
routes.approach: Two primary approaches: (1) From the Cutthroat Lake trailhead on Highway 20, hike 1.8 miles with 500 feet elevation gain to Cutthroat Lake (4,800 ft).
